description: ContextLens - 100% Local-first AI developer context engine and persistent knowledge graph for VS Code.

scripts.release:patch: node scripts/bump.js patch && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version [skip ci]" && git push origin dev && git checkout main && git merge dev && git push origin main && git checkout dev
scripts.release:minor: node scripts/bump.js minor && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version [skip ci]" && git push origin dev && git checkout main && git merge dev && git push origin main && git checkout dev
scripts.release:major: node scripts/bump.js major && git add -A && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version [skip ci]" && git push origin dev && git checkout main && git merge dev && git push origin main && git checkout dev
